reader.requirement: After a report heading is presented at --std 85 the RWCS sets LINE-COUNTER to the absolute NEXT GROUP integer (a), the final print line plus a relative NEXT GROUP integer (b, paged and unpaged), zero for NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE (c), the final print line when NEXT GROUP is absent (d), and leaves LINE-COUNTER unchanged for a nonprintable (no LINE NUMBER) report heading (e).
reader.edition-search: grep -n 'Edition|DialectBehavior' ReportWriter.cs gives lines 734, 964, 1080, 1490 only (SumPresentable, GenerateCore, TerminateCore, WithPageGroupControlValues); none is on the report heading path GenerateCore -> PresentHeadingFooting -> BeginGroup/PresentLines/PresentLine -> ApplyNextGroup(ReportHeading arm) -> PageFeed. ReportWriterEmitter#EmitReportConstruction bakes Edition into CobolReport but nothing on this path reads it. The binder's NEXT GROUP legality checks (COBOL2284) are syntax rules, not this GR.
reader.witnesses-cover: all of the rule's range at this edition (g85_bf36_01: a, b paged and unpaged, c, d paged and unpaged, e)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.6 GR5  (3.10.6 Report Heading Group Presentation Rules)  the text is in GR5

reader.notes: ApplyNextGroup's ReportHeading arm sets LINE-COUNTER = integer (5a), += integer after PresentLine left it on the final line (5b), and for NEXT PAGE calls PageFeed which zeroes it (5c); with no NEXT GROUP the last PresentLine value stands (5d); BeginGroup returns false for a group with no line, so nothing moves (5e). The witness and the probes agree, and the 2023 run is identical.
